title: KOLUSU: Scariest South Indian Horror BGM (original score)
description:
Midnight in an old village house by a deep well. Anklet bells walk across the empty hall, a woman hums a lullaby nobody should know, the wind stops... and she is right behind you.

A South Indian horror score: a ghost's lullaby in a dark raga, kolusu anklet bells, a possession ritual drum gallop, a splash in the well and two jump scares. Headphones on, lights off.

Music: Kolusu, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
